title: Building an Integrated Sign Ordering Operation
summary: A custom WordPress platform connected CRM, vendor ordering, Kanban tracking, process stages, and employee work.
principles: An operational system should make the whole workflow visible, not digitize isolated fragments.
looking_back: This is substantial enough to document both as a project and as a case study: the project describes the platform; the case study explains the operational system it replaced.
body: The signage operation had no shared CRM, vendor ordering process, work-in-progress view, or employee task visibility.
Multiple functions needed to work together within infrastructure the team already understood.
I built a WordPress-based platform combining client records, vendor ordering, a Kanban board, stage lists, and employee work tracking.
The full order lifecycle became visible in one system, from client request through vendor work and completion.

perspectives.name: Julie
perspectives.text: The value was integration. Five disconnected tools would have preserved five disconnected versions of the operation.

perspectives.name: Nam
perspectives.text: The platform turned an informal sequence into an inspectable operational model.

perspectives.name: Jae
perspectives.text: Client, vendor, stage, owner, status: one shared picture.
